testcase.name: Text IME and popup focus take priority and pointer movement never steals focus
New workspaces capture actual reference proportions and retain a resized user column
Compact transform settings keep feedback visible and restore their row through menus
Reference layout uses a narrow right column and thin output around the actual GL viewport
Workbench tools reuse actions and selection data with a usable minimum viewport
Panel menu opens resizable regions and restores the viewport without changing editing
Polished workbench retains readable controls and GL context at minimum size
Navigation controls update the real camera projection and leave transparent space pickable
Temporary maximization is restored before workspace persistence and handles floating docks
Large editable source has a persistent scale hint without changing history
V2 S01 S02 S08 native top picking survives real workspaces panels and screen DPI
Navigation axis hit targets cover six directions and repeated clicks reverse an aligned axis
Existing v2 layouts round trip through isolated settings and reset only the active layout
Navigation cancels captured modeling input and isolates camera preview and gesture cancellation
Maximize uses frozen F3 area and covers properties while preserving text priority
Shortcut dialog validates before accepting and cancellation retains the binding
Short scene region exposes working collection controls through its visible tab
Compact workbench buttons execute cancel repeat and history through existing actions
Viewport tool overlay owns its buttons background and wheel without scene input
Legacy actions dispatch once and Blender does not fall back to old keys
Chinese paths and errors retain document data and underlying diagnostics
Workspaces restore independent preferences without changing document or GL context
Maximize shortcut rebind rejects conflicts persists and disables the old combination
Legacy shortcuts keep working after navigation release and Escape without stealing text focus
Keymap distinguishes main digits keypad and conflicting legacy transform bindings
Blender input follows the pointer area but rejects another window
Chinese input preserves user names and localized duplicate history
Qt dialogs and context menus use embedded Chinese with native defaults enabled
V2 native half shell keeps Mirror clipping source distinction and reversible apply
Workbench regions preserve GL identity and keep sidebar clicks outside picking
Chinese interface keeps identifiers and fits minimum window
Ctrl Space maximizes the pointer viewport and restores layout without GL replacement
